system.description:
CLASS GYMNAST

You let enemy momentum work against them, slipping past and striking when they overcommit.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 4 ranks

When you succeed at a Tumble (Acrobatics) check, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to attack rolls against that creature until the end of your turn.

If your Tumble Through result is a critical, your next attack against that creature gains Advantage.

Automated: after a successful Tumble against a creature: +1 circumstance to your attacks against it until the end of your turn; after a critical one, advantage on your next attack against it as well, spent by that attack. Both applied for you, and gone at the end of your turn.
